title: Transverse Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The maximum transverse momentum of the pion is correctly calculated as 206 MeV/c.

title: Longitudinal Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The maximum longitudinal momentum of the pion is correctly calculated as 540 MeV/c.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The use of energy conservation to relate the energies of the pions to the mass of the K0L meson is correctly applied.

title: Lorentz Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The understanding that the transverse momentum remains unchanged under Lorentz transformation is correctly stated.

title: Momentum Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the pion momentum in the rest frame of K0L is accurately derived.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: No sign errors are present in the calculations of momentum and energy.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: All units are correctly maintained throughout the calculations.
